_comment: The models llama-swap offers on Framework (docs/llama-swap/plan.md, phase 4). Installed to
llama-swap's config from this file and the builds on disk: one entry per model and backend, named
<id>-<nathanw|upstream|hip>, plus a -candidate entry while that backend has a candidate build different from current.
settings: llama-server settings (keys: ctx_size, parallel, jinja, chat_template_file, chat_template_kwargs, reasoning_format,
reasoning_budget, temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, extra_args), after the common flags (port 8080, API key, --alias <entry id>, all layers on GPU).
variants: [{suffix, label, settings}] -> extra entries <id>-<backend>[-candidate]-<suffix>, settings layered over the model's.
Overrides changed later (the panel's Models page) live in /etc/llama-builds/overrides.json on Framework, layered over this file.
backends: the llama-builds backends that can load the model (fork, upstream, upstream-hip).
Chat templates for GGUFs that lack one (Ollama copies) are in files/llama-swap/templates/ -> /etc/llama-builds/templates/.
default: the entry loaded at boot (llama-swap-preload.service).
Weights' size for llm-memgate is measured from the files when the config is written.
